tithi.name: कृष्ण तृतीया
tithi.description: आत्मनिरीक्षण और पिछले बोझों को छोड़ने का दिन; आध्यात्मिक अभ्यास से आंतरिक स्पष्टता प्राप्त होती है।

Mesha.summary: New opportunities arise, but patience is required.
Mesha.general: The day encourages careful planning; avoid impulsive decisions. Meditation will help maintain balance.
Mesha.career: Creative ideas surface; channel them into concrete proposals. Team collaboration yields better results.
Mesha.finance: Small gains are possible; steer clear of speculative investments today.
Mesha.relationships: Open communication resolves lingering misunderstandings. Show appreciation to loved ones.
Mesha.health: Mindful breathing exercises will reduce stress. Stay hydrated and avoid heavy meals.
Mesha.remedy: Light a ghee lamp and chant the Gayatri mantra.

Vrishabha.summary: Personal confidence shines, making it a favorable day.
Vrishabha.general: Your inner stability radiates outward, attracting support. Trust your instincts in decisions.
Vrishabha.career: Leadership roles feel natural; take initiative on pending projects.
Vrishabha.finance: Steady income streams are reinforced; consider saving a portion of earnings.
Vrishabha.relationships: Romantic bonds deepen through shared activities. Family harmony is highlighted.
Vrishabha.health: Physical stamina is high; a light workout will be invigorating.
Vrishabha.remedy: Offer water to a peepal tree and recite the Vishnu Sahasranama.

Mithuna.summary: Communication flows smoothly, aiding personal growth.
Mithuna.general: Emotions may feel confined; express them constructively. Avoid overthinking.
Mithuna.career: Finish pending tasks before starting new ones; multitasking may cause errors.
Mithuna.finance: Unexpected expenses could arise; keep a buffer.
Mithuna.relationships: Misunderstandings can surface; practice active listening.
Mithuna.health: Digestive system is sensitive; opt for light, warm foods.
Mithuna.remedy: Donate yellow sweets to a child’s home and chant the Saraswati mantra.

Karka.summary: Emotional depth offers chances for healing.
Karka.general: Family matters gain prominence; nurture bonds with compassion. Reflect on past patterns.
Karka.career: Team projects benefit from your empathy; avoid taking on too much alone.
Karka.finance: Steady income continues; a modest charitable donation brings blessings.
Karka.relationships: Intimate conversations strengthen trust. Plan a quiet evening with partner.
Karka.health: Emotional balance supports immunity; practice gentle yoga.
Karka.remedy: Offer milk to a cow and chant the Om Namah Shivaya mantra.

Simha.summary: Leadership qualities are highlighted; use them wisely.
Simha.general: Your charisma attracts opportunities; stay humble. Public speaking goes well.
Simha.career: Presentations and negotiations are favored; showcase your ideas confidently.
Simha.finance: Profits from earlier investments may materialize; consider reinvesting wisely.
Simha.relationships: Social gatherings bring joy; share your enthusiasm with friends.
Simha.health: Energy levels are high; a brisk walk will be refreshing.
Simha.remedy: Light a camphor lamp and recite the Hanuman Chalisa.

Kanya.summary: Attention to detail brings success in tasks.
Kanya.general: Organize your space to enhance mental clarity. Small routines yield big results.
Kanya.career: Analytical work is favored; finish reports with precision.
Kanya.finance: Budget reviews are beneficial; avoid impulsive purchases.
Kanya.relationships: Offer practical help to loved ones; it deepens bonds.
Kanya.health: Focus on joint health; gentle stretching is advised.
Kanya.remedy: Donate brown lentils to a shelter and chant the Mahamrityunjaya mantra.

Tula.summary: Balance is key; seek harmony in all areas.
Tula.general: Conflicts may arise if you resist compromise. Practice patience and fairness.
Tula.career: Negotiations require flexibility; avoid rigid stances.
Tula.finance: Watch for hidden costs; double‑check contracts.
Tula.relationships: Disagreements can be resolved through open dialogue; avoid blame.
Tula.health: Stress may affect the nervous system; try meditation.
Tula.remedy: Offer pink roses to a deity of love and chant the Radha Krishna mantra.

Vrischika.summary: Intense focus can lead to breakthroughs.
Vrischika.general: Your determination attracts respect; channel it into constructive goals.
Vrischika.career: Research and deep work are favored; you may uncover valuable insights.
Vrischika.finance: Long‑term investments show promise; avoid short‑term speculation.
Vrischika.relationships: Passionate conversations deepen intimacy; be honest about feelings.
Vrischika.health: Physical stamina is strong; a moderate workout will be beneficial.
Vrischika.remedy: Donate black sesame seeds and chant the Maha Mrityunjaya mantra.

Dhanu.summary: Constructive and favorable day ahead for Dhanu.
Dhanu.general: A balanced day with steady opportunities for Dhanu. Focus your energy on core priorities.
Dhanu.career: Professional efforts yield constructive progress. Maintain diligence and collaborative communication.
Dhanu.finance: Financial outlook remains stable. Thoughtful planning supports long-term prosperity.
Dhanu.relationships: Warmth and mutual understanding flourish in personal ties. Spend quality time with loved ones.
Dhanu.health: Vitality is steady. Practice mindfulness and maintain consistent daily hydration and rest.
Dhanu.remedy: Offer water to Surya Dev in the morning and chant Om Namah Shivaya.
